result.summary: Found 3 visual issues. The most obvious broken item is a pricing/content bug showing “€NaN delivery”. There are also some clipped carousel elements on the right edge and a restaurant name that is truncated without a clear affordance.

issues.description: The delivery fee for “Smash Bros Burgers” displays as “€NaN delivery”, which indicates a broken or missing numeric value.
issues.suggestion: Add fallback handling for missing/invalid delivery fee values, such as showing “Delivery fee unavailable”, “Free delivery”, or hiding the fee until valid data is available.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrollable elements are visibly cut off on the right edge, including the category chip row and the third restaurant card in “Fastest near you”. This may be intentional carousel behavior, but it looks abrupt and slightly broken in the screenshot.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right padding or show a clearer carousel affordance so partially visible items feel intentional rather than clipped.

issues.description: The restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol…” is truncated in the “Fastest near you” row, making the full name unavailable at a glance.
issues.suggestion: Increase card width, allow two-line restaurant names, or ensure truncation uses a proper ellipsis with enough context.
